description: Gares de voyageurs is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Une gare est un ensemble de biens fonciers, pour lequel SNCF G&C est affectataire en droit réel de la propriété de l'Etat ou d'un propriétaire tiers, ayant servi, servant ou qui servira à l'interface entre la ville et le train. Ce jeu de données représente l'ensemble des gares répondant à la définition ci-dessus. Coverage: France. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Gares. Its keywords are Gare de voyageurs, Gares de voyageurs, Gares, gare, Géolocalisation, Code UIC. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
